svg.text: Combines my own value (this first v) with the one my partner sent, and
stores the result back in v. op is quad_reduce's second argument,
chosen where the kernel calls it:

svg.text: The PTX instruction shfl.sync in bfly (butterfly) mode. The mode
decides whose register each lane reads. In butterfly mode lanes swap
in pairs; the name comes from the crossed pairs of the FFT's butterfly

svg.text: The value this lane sends, a Float32 in a register: here the maximum
of its own 16 scores of the row. Every lane sends its v and gets its
partner's back, all in one instruction, without touching memory.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: In butterfly mode the partner is lane ^ offset. 2 = 0b10 flips bit 1:
0↔2, 1↔3. The next line's offset=1 flips bit 0: 0↔1, 2↔3. Bits 2–4
never change, so a partner is always in the same quad.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: 1 = 0b01 ^ 0b10 = 0b11 = 3. Lanes 4–7 pair up the same way.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Which lanes take part, one bit per lane. -1 is 0xFFFFFFFF: all 32. The
.sync means each of them must reach this instruction; the hardware
waits for them. All 8 quads swap at once.
bit: 0 … 31, one per lane, all 1 (lanes 0–3 = quad 0, …, 28–31 = quad 7)

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: Two numbers packed in one integer. Bits 0–4, the clamp: the highest
lane a partner may be; past it, a lane gets its own v back. Bits 8–12,
the segment mask: split the warp into groups (0: one group of 32).
lane ^ 2 never passes 31, so 31 means: the whole warp, no clamping.

svg.text: Both lines of quad_reduce on quad 0, for the maximum of row 0
Each lane starts with the maximum of its own 16 scores. Quads 1–7 do the same at the same time, on rows 1–7.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: After line 1, lanes 0 and 2 hold max(lanes 0, 2),
After line 2 every lane holds 7, the maximum
of the row: 2 shuffles for 4 lanes.
For the row sum, op is + and the same two
